utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, um, I think maybe we can start? Is everyone here, or are we waiting on-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Wei's still getting his laptop sorted, I saw him in the corridor.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Here. Go.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Great. So, uh, thanks for coming in on a Thursday, I know the first week back is always, you know, messy.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Messy is generous. My inbox has like four hundred things from the break.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Four hundred, that's nothing, I had Sione forward me his whole-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Sorry, Kofi, can we, I think maybe we should do the budget thing first and then catch up on inboxes?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Yeah, yeah, fair.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: So the, um, the cut. Next year's number came down from the leadership group before the holidays, and it's eight percent.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Eight percent of what, the whole company spend or just the controllable bits?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I think, um, maybe the whole operating budget? I'd have to check the memo.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Check it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I will. I will, after this. Anyway, the question is how we apply it, and, uh, nothing's fixed yet.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Right, because the big picture is we need to land somewhere sensible and not wreck anyone's year.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Which is basically impossible if you-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Kofi, let people finish, please.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Sorry, go on.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: No, I was done. I just meant it's a lot of moving parts.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Can I, um. Can I say something?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Of course, Ivan, please.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: So, what if we just, um, take eight percent off every department. Same cut for all of them.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Across the board, you mean?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Yeah. Across the board. Every department's line, down eight.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Flat cut.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Right.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, I think maybe that's, um, worth hearing out. Ivan, what's the thinking?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Well, it's easy to explain, for one. Nobody has to defend a number against anybody else's.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: People will still complain though, they always-

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: They will, but nobody can say they got singled out. That's the, the thing people care about.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: That's a fair point, honestly. Perception matters a lot in these rounds.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: And the timing works. The budget file locks around the twentieth, and a flat percentage is something we can just load in. No back and forth with fifteen heads.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Mm.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Plus, um, once they have the new total, each head can decide where it comes out of. Hiring, travel, whatever they'd rather give up.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: So we don't pick for them.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Right. They know their own areas better than we do.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Except that some of them will just, like, cut the training line and leave the same headcount, and then we-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Kofi, hang on, I think maybe let's park that. Ivan hasn't finished, has he?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: No, that was mostly it. Sorry, I'm not great at this.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: No, no, that was clear. Really clear.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I do wonder if some departments are already lean, though. Like, eight percent on a department that's mostly salaries is a different animal.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: True.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yeah. Um. That's a, a good flag, Yuki, I think maybe we need numbers for that.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I mean, I don't have them. I just have a feeling about it.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Facilities is basically all fixed cost. Rent and, you know, the contract with-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Esra's team handles the facilities contract, right?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Yeah, Esra, and Laszlo sits on that too, I think.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay. We might want to ask Esra what's actually flexible there.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Ask her.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I'll, uh, I'll send something this afternoon. Or tomorrow. Tomorrow's probably better.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Is anyone else getting a weird error when they open the shared forecast sheet? It keeps greying out the columns.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Mine did that yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: It's because someone has it open in the old version. Gabor, I think. He never closes anything.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Tell him.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I did, twice.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, okay, I think maybe that's a thing for IT. Can someone just message them?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I'll do it, it's like two lines.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Thanks, Yuki.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Speaking of Gabor, did you see he's moving to the Rotterdam office in March?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: No way. Really? I thought that fell through.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Camille told me. Apparently they sorted the visa thing.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: He talked about Rotterdam before. His partner's from there.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Oh, that makes sense then. Good for him.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Um, that's lovely. I think maybe we should, though, go back to the, the cut.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Sorry, yeah. Tangent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: No, it's fine, it's, um, it's a Thursday. But we do have to actually get somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Where's the deadline from?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Ivan said the twentieth, and I think that's right, I'd want to confirm with Beatriz.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Beatriz owns the file.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: She does. She owns the file lock.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: And is the twentieth hard or is it like, a soft-ish date?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I think it's soft-ish? Honestly I don't know.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Last year they let it slide a week, but then the quarter close got-

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Right, and everyone was cranky.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I thought it didn't slide last year. I thought it was the, um, the twenty-fourth that was the real one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Could be. I'd have to look back.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Not important now.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: No. No, you're right.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: What I keep coming back to is whether finance leadership cares more about speed or fairness here. Like, which one do they actually want.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Um, I think maybe both, which is the annoying answer.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: They always want both.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Mm. Fair.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay. So where are we? We have, um, the flat cut on the table. Does anyone want to, uh, say something about that?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Not yet.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I'd want to see what it does in dollars by department before I say anything. Like, a real table, not a percentage.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: That seems reasonable. Could you, Kofi, pull that together? Or, uh, maybe Ivan, since it was your idea-

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I can try. Which sheet has last year's actuals?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: It's in the, um, the shared drive, under planning, I think? Or maybe it's under the archive folder.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Planning. The archive one is two years back.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Okay. I'll find it.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Should we loop in the department heads before we get too far? Or is that jumping ahead?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I think maybe it's early. I don't want to send out a number that we haven't, you know, agreed on.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Sure, yeah. I just don't want them blindsided.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: No, of course. We'll tell them well before the twentieth.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: How much before.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Um. Probably a week? Ish?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Ish.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: A week isn't enough for the bigger departments, they need to run it by their own people and-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, that's, that's another thing to think about. Let's write it down.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I'll put it in the notes.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Thank you. Right. So, I have a hard stop in about five minutes, there's a thing with Beatriz about the audit calendar.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Is that the one about the sampling dates?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes, that one, it keeps moving.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Of course it does.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: So, um, next steps. Ivan, the table by department. I'll check the memo on what the eight percent applies to, and ask Esra about facilities.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: And I'll ping IT about the sheet.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Great. And we'll come back to this next time, I think, once we have the numbers in front of us.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks everyone. I'm going to run, sorry, I'm late already.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Go, go. We'll sort out the notes.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, um, I think maybe we can start. Is, uh, is everybody-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Ivan's here, Yuki's here, Wei's here. We're all here.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Great. Thanks. So, I looked at the memo, finally.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: And?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Whole operating budget. Not just the controllable bits. So, um, Yuki, that answers your question from last week.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay, good. Bigger than I'd hoped, but good to know.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: And I, uh, I did write to Esra about facilities. She hasn't come back yet.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: She never replies before Wednesday. Ask Laszlo, he'll know.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I think maybe I'll give her till Friday first.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I did the, um, the table. By department. It's in the folder.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Oh, wonderful. Thank you, Ivan. Did you find the actuals okay?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Planning folder, like you said. Kofi was right about the archive one.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Told you.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: So, uh, has everyone seen it? Or, I mean, opened it?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I skimmed it on the train. Sorry, big picture only.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I read it. The flat one hits sales ops weirdly hard, their number is mostly salaries so-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Kofi, can we, I think maybe let Wei go first? He said he had something.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Yeah. I went through the contract register.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Oh, right, the, um, the commitments thing.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Sixty-two percent of the budget is already tied up in multi-year contracts. Can't touch it this cycle.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Sixty-two? I thought it was around half.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: It's sixty-two. I counted twice.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, so, um, what does that mean for the cut, practically?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Eight percent of the whole thing comes out of what's left. Roughly a fifth of the uncommitted lines. Twenty-one, about.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Hang on, that's, that's a lot more than eight-

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Huh. Okay. Um. That changes the feel of it, doesn't it.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: So the flat one isn't really flat then. Not in what people feel.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Flat on paper.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Right, and, so, I mean, if it's a fifth of what's actually movable, then, um, why are we spreading it over everything?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Say more?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: What if we aim it? Travel, contractors, events. The uncommitted stuff in those. Take the eight out of there and leave the rest.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Same total?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Same total, yeah. Same eight percent, it just lands somewhere specific.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: So, um, targeted, you mean. Instead of everyone.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Yes. Targeted.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Which lines exactly.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I'd need the sheet for exact. Those three are the obvious ones, there's more flexibility there.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Mm. Okay.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Is there enough in those three to cover it? Like, in dollars?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I haven't, I haven't run that. I think so? Kofi, you've got the travel numbers.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Somewhere. I'd have to dig.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: That's something we'd want to check, I think maybe.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: The reason I like it, though, is the other way squeezes everything evenly. If every uncommitted line loses a fifth, that includes the tooling renewals.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: The product ones?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Yeah, those come due in the second quarter. Spread thin, we can't renew them at the current level, and then hiring slows down too because nobody's got room.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: The renewals are quoted already.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Right. So they'd be a problem. Concentrated, we protect those and the headcount lines.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: But travel and events, people are going to hate-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Kofi, I think maybe let her finish first.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Sorry. She finished.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I did, it's fine. He's not wrong, though, somebody's going to hate it.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Some of the contractors are on projects mid-flight, I think.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Is that, um, is that all of them?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I don't know. Not all. Sione would know, he manages half of them.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Right. We could ask him, I'd say.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Ask.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I will. Um. After this. Or tomorrow. I'll put it in the notes so I don't lose it.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I'll put it in the notes. I'm already writing.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Thanks, Yuki.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Can I switch to something totally different for a second? It's small.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Is it on the, uh, on the list?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: It's not on the list. It's the expense thing.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, go on, but quickly.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: So the limit where it's just a manager signing off, it's five hundred. Above that it needs a second person. I think we raise it to a thousand.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Why, um, why a thousand?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Because those claims just sit. Between five hundred and a thousand, they wait about four days on average for the second signature.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: How many get rejected?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: None. Last year, none at all in that range. I checked the log.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Four days feels long for a taxi receipt.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: It's mostly conference fees and the odd flight change, but yeah.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Oh, that's easy. Nobody's gaming that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Um, does finance control need to sign off on moving the number?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Beatriz did, last month. Kind of. She said it was fine if we recommended it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Kind of.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: She said it in the corridor. I can email her to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, no, I think that's enough for me. The manager-only limit goes up to a thousand dollars.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Great. I'll write it up and get the policy page changed.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Tell Camille, she does the page.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Right, Camille.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Does it apply from today?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Um, let's say from the first of next month. Or, I mean, once the page is updated.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: The page is quick. I can do it this week.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Good. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Done?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Done, yeah. Back to the, the cut.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Did anyone else see the thing about the new coffee place downstairs? Sorry, I know, tangent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Oh, I think maybe not right now-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: What thing?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: They're replacing the sandwich counter. Gabor was telling me, he's, um, he's going to miss the old one before he moves.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: He's still going to Rotterdam?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: March, yeah. He's packing already, apparently.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: He told me he's taking the standing desk.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: They won't let him.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: He said he already asked.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, okay. I think maybe we should-

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Sorry. Yes. Back.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: So, where, where do we stand on the cut? We have the flat one, and the, um, the targeted one.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: And the numbers are different now that we know about the contracts.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Right.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I'd still want to see the targeted one by line. Not the idea. The dollars.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Fair. Yuki, could you do that? Or, um, with Kofi's travel numbers?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Yes. I can. I'm not great at the detail but I'll sit with Kofi.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I'll send you what I have.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: And the file lock, I think it's still around the twentieth. I'd have to ask Beatriz.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Ask her today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay. Okay, today. I'll message her after this.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I might need to leave in a few minutes, I have a thing at eleven.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Oh, sure, of course. Is there anything else anyone needs from me?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Just Esra on facilities.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Friday. I'll nudge on Friday. Okay. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, um, can everyone hear me? The speaker in this room has been, uh, crackly all week.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Sounds fine. Ivan's here, Wei's here, Yuki's just sitting down.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Here, sorry. The stairwell door was jammed, I had to go all the way round-

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Start.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Right. So, I think maybe we've gone round and round on the cut for two weeks, and I'd like to, you know, actually close it today.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Finally.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Before that, though. Esra, did she ever- no wait, I asked that last time. Did anyone hear from her?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: She wrote back Friday. Facilities is nearly all fixed. Rent, the cleaning contract. A little bit in maintenance.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Told you. She doesn't reply before Wednesday and then it's a paragraph.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay. So that's basically out either way.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Which is sort of the big picture. Anything that's actually soft is the discretionary stuff, not the buildings.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Mm. And I got to Sione, finally. About the contractors.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: And?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: He said, um, around half of his people finish up by the end of March. The others are mid-project and he'd rather we leave them.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: So some room, but not all of it.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Some, yeah.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: That's what I was saying last time, they can't all be-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Kofi, I think maybe let me finish. And Beatriz says the lock is the twenty-fourth. Not the twentieth.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: I did say the twenty-fourth.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: You did. You did, sorry, Ivan. I had it in my head as the twentieth.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Four more days.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Which isn't a lot, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Kofi, did the three lines come together? The ones from the sheet?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I sent you travel. Events I pulled this morning. Contractors I kind of guessed from Sione's list.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Got them. I put everything on one tab. It covers it, I think. Travel's the big chunk, events are, um, smaller.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: How close.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: With contractors in it clears the number. Thirty thousand over? Something like that, I'd want to look again.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: It's closer to twenty-five, I had it on my-

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay, twenty-five. Still over.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay. That's, um, that's helpful. That's good.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Can I ask something totally unrelated? Who's doing the card for Gabor?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Oh. Is, um, is that going round already?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Camille started one. It's on her desk, I think. Nobody's signed it.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I haven't seen it. What are we getting him, a gift thing?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: A voucher, maybe. Something for the new place.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: He asked for a proper kettle. I'm not joking.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: A kettle. For Rotterdam.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: He said theirs are different.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: They are, they're the- never mind, I'll ask Camille what she's collecting.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: How much each.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Ten? Fifteen? She didn't say.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay, okay. I think maybe we should come back. Sorry. Kofi, you can sort that out afterwards.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Yep. Sorry.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: So. The flat one, versus aiming it. Does anyone, um, want to say anything that they haven't already?

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Um. I still think the flat one is easier to explain. That was my whole reason.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: It was a good reason. It is.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: But the thing Wei found changed it for me. If it's mostly landing on the stuff that's not locked anyway, then it isn't really even.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Yeah.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: And the tooling renewals. They come due in the second quarter, and the quotes are in. If everything uncommitted takes the hit, those are exposed.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: But the people running travel are going to be furious. Like, properly-

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Some people will be, yes.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: -furious, because they've got conferences booked already, half of them-

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Booked or committed? There's a difference, isn't there.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Booked and paid is committed. Booked but not paid, that's still in the uncommitted number.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Right, okay. So that's in Yuki's figure already?

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: I used the uncommitted column, so yes. I think. Kofi gave me the split.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I did.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Um. Ivan, is there anything about the flat one that's still bothering you? You can say.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: No. Not really. I just don't want to be the one who, um. If a head complains.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: No, that's, that's mine to deal with. Not yours.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: And if it's the flat one we get fifteen emails anyway.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: We'd get a different fifteen.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay. I think maybe I've heard enough. Yeah. The cut goes on travel, contractors and events, only the uncommitted lines in those, adding up to the eight percent. Targeted, not across everyone.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Good.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Done.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Okay. Should I redo the sheet so it shows that and not the old version?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes, please. Um, with Kofi's final split, not the guess for the contractors.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I'll get Sione to confirm his list this week.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: And the department heads need to hear before the lock. Um, this week, ideally. Before the weekend?

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Who sends.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: I will. I'll draft it and you can all look at it. Maybe Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Yuki
utterances.text: Draft it tomorrow, we'll fix it Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Yes. That works better.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Should I take my table off the shared folder? So nobody opens the old one?

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Um, rename it, maybe. Put old in the name.

utterances.speaker: Ivan
utterances.text: Okay. I'll do that.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I have to go, I've got the vendor call at eleven.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Oh, sure, go. Thanks, Kofi.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: And I'll find Camille about the card.

utterances.speaker: Wei
utterances.text: Bye.

utterances.speaker: Aisha
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks, everyone.
